name: Solemn Scarlet! Conductor Outfit
desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
lore: An exquisite uniform that Pom-Pom wears while welcoming or bidding farewell to guests. It sports carmine velvet with metallic accessories, displaying the conductor's extraordinary bearing. The pocket watch that is cleaned ten times a day is the key to the Express' stable passage.
